bias.en: Bearish · broke $1,518, at the $1,493.5 January high

read.en: ASML fell 3.6% on Nov 4 to $1,496.30, trading between $1,478.96 and $1,532.09. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,563.24), 10-day ($1,583.78), 30-day ($1,693.94) and 100-day ($1,733.60) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,600.02). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,645.29), and RSI is 34.7.

The close broke the $1,530.6–1,550 zone and the $1,518 Nov 2 low; the $1,478.96 low dipped under the $1,493.5 Jan 28 high, but the close held just above it. Resistance is $1,518–1,535, then $1,550–1,575.6 (Oct 23 low, 5-day, Nov 3 high) and $1,583.8–1,601 (10 and 200-day). Support is $1,479–1,493.5, then $1,450. A close above $1,535 would target $1,550–1,576; below $1,479, $1,450.

r.en: Nov 2 low $1,518; Nov 4 high $1,532.1; Oct 30 low $1,535.3
